summary: First empirical CPU-vs-GPU logits diff on canonical 7B teacher (Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct Q4K) using PR-B's APR_GPU_STAGE_DUMP scaffold. Confirms PARITY-GATE cosine=-0.005 is reproducible and quantifies the divergence shape: systematic anti-correlation with max|diff|=19.5 and many top-K elements showing OPPOSITE signs between CPU and GPU.

result.top_divergences_anti_correlated: Many top-|diff| elements show OPPOSITE signs between CPU and GPU (a negative, b positive or vice versa). Systematic anti-correlation, not random noise.

top_10_divergences.note: this is the GPU argmax (CPU has it strongly negative)

what_we_know: CPU logits and GPU logits both produced — not a GPU crash
Cosine = -0.005 (near-zero, slightly negative) confirms the systematic anti-correlation pattern
ALL top-10 divergences have opposite signs — strongly suggests sign-flip class of bug (transpose, stride miscalculation, or negation in a kernel)
max|diff| = 19.5 is large relative to logit scale (typical Qwen logits are ±10) — bug is significant, not numerical noise
what_localizes_further: Need intermediate stage dumps (PostFfnResidual after last layer, FinalNorm post-output-norm) to localize whether bug is in transformer stack or LM head
PR-B's intermediate dump hooks added but didn't fire on this run — likely workspace buffer accessibility issue; needs PR-D investigation
interpretation.bug_class_hypothesis: Layout/stride bug in a matmul kernel (most likely attn_out projection or LM head matmul). The systematic sign-flip points to a transpose-or-stride error rather than a numerical accumulation error.

next_slice_plan: PR-D-a: Fix the workspace buffer dump path in forward_utils.rs (currently silently no-op'ing). Likely needs `self.compute_stream.synchronize()?` before `copy_to_host`.
PR-D-b: With intermediate dumps working, compare CPU vs GPU at PostFfnResidual + FinalNorm. Determines whether bug is in transformer stack (28 layers) or in output_rmsnorm + LM head dispatch.

PR-D-c: If FinalNorm matches but lm_head diverges → bug in LM head dispatch (look at dispatch_lm_head_and_download). If FinalNorm diverges but PostFfnResidual matches → bug in apply_output_rmsnorm. If PostFfnResidual diverges → bisect into the 28-layer stack.
PR-E: Fix the localized stage; rerun apr parity; expect cos >= 0.98 → SHIP-007 LIVE-DISCHARGED → MODEL-1 99% → 100%
